title: Centralize season page data loading instead of repeating fs/path logic
description:
The season pages repeat the same file-loading patterns in multiple places. `website/src/pages/season/[season]/results.astro`, `rankings.astro`, `games.astro`, `entrants.astro`, `draft.astro`, `index.astro`, `player/[seed].astro`, and `match/[matchId].astro` all re-read some combination of `src/data/benchmark-results.json`, `data/tournaments/season-N.json`, and `puppeteer/personalities.json` with near-identical `fs.existsSync`, `fs.readFileSync`, and `path.join(process.cwd(), ...)` code.

This has a few costs:
- Every page frontmatter has bespoke I/O logic.
- The same path conventions are encoded in many files.
- It is easy for one page to drift from the others.
- Testing season-page data behavior requires touching many pages instead of one loader.

Add a shared website utility, for example `website/src/utils/season-data.ts`, with helpers such as:
1. `loadAvailableSeasons()`
2. `loadTournament(season)`
3. `loadSeasonBenchmark(season)`
4. `loadPersonalities()`
5. `hasTournament(season)` / `hasDraft(season)`

Then make the Astro pages thin consumers of that shared loader layer.
